'''Fearful''' is a [[debuff]] that deals [[Cold damage|cold]] [[damage over time]]. It is caused by the "manifestation of fear" near the player character. A manifestation of fear is a water bubble–like, non-targetable object in quicksilver color that appears in several boss arenas and other areas. The orbs then slowly pursue the player and deal cold damage over time when in close proximity.

==Sources==
* [[Sea of Isolation]] (arena of [[The Constrictor]])
* The Pools of Terror in [[The High Gardens]] (arena of [[Yugul, Reflection of Terror]]), and the map variant in [[Terrace]] Map
* [[Gardens]] Map boss arena ([[Sallazzang]])
* several other area

==Trivia==
The debuff shared the same status icon graphic with [[chill]] ailment, [[chilled ground]], etc. However, since Fearful is not an ailment, it cannot be avoided by the passive skills that grant the player character to avoid elemental ailment.
